categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in electrical equipment inspection and testing services, including AC/DC high voltage and ultra-high voltage switchgear, ±500kV DC transmission equipment, and 800kV AC long-distance transmission equipment. Other business segments include metrology services, certification services, technical research, and technical consulting. The core business is testing services, supported by extensive experience and leading technology in electrical equipment testing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses nine major core technologies including electrical equipment product standard research and verification, high voltage large current metrology, high voltage switch testing, winding equipment testing, ±500kV and below DC transmission valve testing, insulator and arrester testing, power capacitor testing, key performance core technologies of electrical equipment, and intelligent manufacturing technologies for electrical equipment. It has developed advanced testing platforms and patented technologies such as 210kA generator circuit breaker testing, ±1100kV DC GIS insulation testing, and vacuum interrupter technologies. The company also leads in standard formulation and international standard participation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international electrical equipment manufacturers, power grid companies such as State Grid and Southern Grid subsidiaries, and research institutes. The company serves the power transmission and distribution industry, including ultra-high voltage and smart grid sectors. It also targets emerging markets like new energy, offshore wind power, and energy storage. Major customers include China Electric Equipment Group and its subsidiaries, as well as international firms like Hitachi Energy and Schneider Electric.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Xi'an and subsidiaries in Jiangsu (Changzhou), Liaoning (Shenyang), and Henan (Pingdingshan). It has expanded overseas business in over twenty countries, including Kazakhstan, Thailand, Middle East countries, Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Singapore, enhancing its international brand and recognition, especially in the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electrical equipment supply chain, providing independent third-party testing, certification, metrology, and technical consulting services. It is positioned as a key quality assurance and technology validation provider supporting manufacturers and end-users in the power transmission and distribution industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on becoming an international public technology smart service platform in electrical equipment quality enhancement. It emphasizes standard leadership, reform, innovation, and talent development. R&D priorities include high-end, intelligent, and green technologies for power transmission and distribution equipment, with active participation in national key projects and international standard setting. The company invests heavily in R&D (over 10% of revenue), focusing on core technologies like environmentally friendly circuit breakers, DC transmission valves, and intelligent equipment testing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of testing services, including type tests, performance tests, and research tests, with formal service agreements. Additional revenue streams include metrology calibration services, certification services, and technical research and consulting. The company uses a direct sales model to maintain close customer relationships and control sales risks.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's electrical equipment testing industry, especially in ultra-high voltage and DC transmission equipment testing. It holds multiple national-level testing centers and is recognized for its technical capabilities and standard-setting influence. Competitors include other domestic and foreign testing institutions, but the company maintains a competitive edge through its comprehensive service portfolio, advanced technology, and strong government and industry affiliations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 798 million, a 5.73% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 228.7 million, up 20.78%. The company’s total assets were about RMB 3.55 billion with net assets of RMB 2.78 billion. R&D investment accounted for 10.62% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented profile. The company completed a significant acquisition in 2024, expanding its consolidated scope and market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its authoritative and comprehensive testing capabilities across a wide voltage range, including ultra-high voltage and DC equipment, supported by national-level laboratories and advanced technology platforms. It offers integrated services combining testing, metrology, certification, and technical consulting, ensuring high reliability and compliance for customers. Its strong brand recognition, international accreditation, and participation in standard-setting bodies differentiate it as a trusted quality assurance partner in the power equipment industry.
